sentences.en: The murderer was convicted and sentenced to life in prison.
sentences.zh: 谋杀犯被判有罪，并被判处终身监禁。

sentences.en: The police quickly got on the track of the murderer.
sentences.zh: 警方很快找到了凶手的线索。

sentences.en: I want everyone to know that I'm not a murderer.
sentences.zh: 我想让每个人都知道，我不是一个杀人犯。
